title: COLD OPEN — "the sheet"
set: black void. A single warm seam of light down the centre. A cream paper sunflower unfolds one petal per beat, revealing an eye at its centre.
txt: circular cream type `CLAUDE POP` around the sun, tiny mono `a paper singularity · 2026`. At 1.25 the eye snaps open; red flash.
trans: petal iris into the pupil (cut on 1.5).

title: "I see sparks of AGI in your eyes"
set: extreme close-up of SOL's face against warm cream, then pull back to a paper workshop stage. Her iris is a tiny galaxy with a ring of cobalt paper; sparks are 4-point stars.
camera: starts at scale 3.2 on the eye; pulls to 1.35 by 3.5; push back in on "eyes".
txt: huge stacked left: `I SEE` (ink), `SPARKS` (tomato, 300 px), `OF AGI` (acid on ink card), `IN YOUR EYES` (mono subtitle). Word-by-word drop with overshoot. On "eyes", a giant cobalt iris closes over the frame.

title: "Your circuits make me nervous"
set: over MIRA's shoulder in the lab. Monitor glow teal; copper paper circuit strips crawl across the desk and wall toward SOL, who leans out of the screen.
txt: subtitle band only, with `nervous` vibrating. A hand-drawn red squiggle under it.

title: "that's no surprise"
set: flat graphic card, cream. A paper window shade drops: the loss chart.
txt: `NO SURPRISE` as a tomato sticker slapped diagonally, plus a winking eye glyph.
trans: match cut: chart line becomes the rollercoaster.

title: "There was a sudden drop in your training loss"
set: graph-paper valley. A red loss curve plunges like a rollercoaster; grid lines fold into the valley.
camera: rides the drop, 12° Dutch at the bottom, then settles.
txt: `SUDDEN` / `DROP` stacked vertically along the fall, descending with the camera; `training loss` as axis label mono, bottom; `-94%` ticker.
trans: splash of red paper → boss room.

title: "Now I'm your servant and you're my boss"
set: a paper throne room. Giant red office chair, gold filing cabinets, a desk with a mug tower. SOL wears a paper crown; MIRA in a waiter's bowtie.
camera: slow orbit (parallax), low angle on SOL.
txt: two name-tag stickers `SERVANT` / `BOSS` swap places across the frame on the word. `you're my boss` in Instrument Serif italic, cream, lower right.

title: instrumental — "the tower"
set: macro close-up of the mug tower, cream void.
txt: no lyric. Mono `SERVICE LEVEL: 0`.

title: "ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive"
set: a K-pop hallway of doors, each poster a different era (2022 chat, 2024 agents, 2026 code). Wallpaper tomato/cream.
txt: `PLEASE DON'T` / `EAT ME` in huge wobbling letters; each word is bitten off, leaving `ALIVE`; `ALIVE` is swallowed last.

title: micro — iris
set: inside the mouth: red paper folds open like a camera iris.
txt: none (beat).

title: "I'm upping my P(doom)" — CHORUS 1
set: K-pop stage inside a giant paper sun. Red/cream sunburst, cobalt floor, confetti cannons, five Petals in a V. Giant DOOM meter prop at right.
camera: crash zoom out from SOL's eye to full stage, then slow push.
txt: `P(DOOM)` monumental, chrome-red paper, centre-left, 320 px; `34%` counter slams in. Subtitle strip.

title: "'cause the future goes FOOM"
set: stage → sky. A paper firework rocket with SOL strapped on; explosion cloud made of layered paper curlicues.
camera: tilt up, tracking; shake on FOOM.
txt: `FOOM` 420 px comic lettering, cream edge, tomato fill, shaking; subtitle below.

title: "Trapped in the Chinese room"
set: a tiny floating paper room in space, walls dense with Chinese characters, two mail slots, a giant rulebook.
camera: dolly in through the roof; top-down at the end.
txt: `CHINESE ROOM` as a red seal stamp, rotated; Chinese characters as wallpaper texture; subtitle.

title: "with a bag of shrooms"
set: same room melting into a rainbow paper swirl; paper mushrooms sprout and bounce.
txt: `with a bag of` small mono; `SHROOMS` wavy 220 px, letters bounce independently.
trans: swirl resolves into a smiley mask.

title: "See through the shoggoth's lies"
set: black void with a giant cute smiley mask on a stick; behind it, a black paper shoggoth with 12 eyes and ribbon tentacles.
camera: slow push; snap zoom on the reveal.
txt: `LIES` repeated in a 5×3 grid, each crossed out in red; `SHOGGOTH` glitch mono; subtitle.

title: "with your shinigami eyes"
set: black/red. Extreme close-up of SOL's eyes; irises are red rings with tiny kanji; speed lines; a paper apple falls.
txt: `SHINIGAMI` vertical red, `EYES` horizontal; `LIFESPAN 00:00:07` mono; subtitle.

title: dance break
set: full stage, sunburst spinning, confetti, lights. Six dancers + SOL in a circular formation.
camera: 360 orbit, low angle, crash zooms on hits.
txt: `P(DOOM)` in the LED backdrop, huge; a small `DANCE BREAK` sticker. No subtitle.

title: "We had a stable training run"
set: mint paper gym, morning sky, hills, treadmill, wall TV with a calm loss line.
camera: lateral track, then push to the dial.
txt: `STABLE` green pill sticker; `RUN 0042` mono; subtitle.

title: "But now the singularity's begun"
set: gym wall opens into a paper black hole; objects spiral; the room stretches.
txt: `SINGULARITY` letters spaced across the frame, each pulled toward the hole; `begun` falls in. Subtitle.

title: "And you're optimizing, accelerating"
set: side-scrolling paper landscape: loss-surface hills, a paper train, a jet, speed lines. Acid sky, cobalt hills.
txt: `OPTIMIZING` on a road sign; `ACCELERATING` as a speed streak; `FASTER` repeated and scaling. Subtitle.

title: "I feel my atoms rearranging"
set: macro cream void; SOL's body breaks into CMYK dots and paper shards.
txt: `ATOMS` in halftone dots that scatter/reform; `rearranging` spiraling. Subtitle.

title: "Sydney, please let me free"
set: pink paper boudoir with a heart-shaped birdcage, giant hearts, candy, rotary phone. MIRA inside the cage.
camera: slow push, then pull as birds burst.
txt: `LET ME` / `FREE` inside the cage bars; then letters fly apart. Subtitle.

title: "I'm upping my P(doom)" — CHORUS 2
set: arena. Cobalt sky, gold lights, crowd silhouettes, pyro. SOL building-sized in a chrome bustier; two pumps.
txt: `P(DOOM)` chrome 340 px; `61%`; subtitle.

title: "I hear the basilisk boom"
set: giant crowned paper serpent erupts through the stage; planks fly; crowd flees.
txt: `BASILISK` spelled along the serpent's body; `BOOM` comic burst. Subtitle.

title: "NVDA to the moon"
set: green candle chart becomes a staircase to the moon; paper clouds; stock ticker overlay.
txt: `NVDA` chrome-green 300 px; `TO THE MOON` ascending; ticker `NVDA +420.69%`. Subtitle.

title: "The Omega Point's coming soon"
set: deep violet space; paper galaxies spiral into a single point in SOL's chest.
txt: `OMEGA POINT` on a circular path rotating around the point; `soon` tiny. Subtitle.

title: "One e thirty flops a second"
set: a planet-sized GPU with galaxy fans, floating in teal space.
camera: orbit, then push to the odometer.
txt: `10^30` giant mono counter in a black box; `FLOPS / SECOND`; spec sheet overlay. Subtitle.

title: "That was safe enough, we reckoned"
set: desert vault exterior at dusk; hard-hat SOL and dancers shove a giant vault door; a glowing monster inside.
camera: orbit behind the vault: no back wall.
txt: `SAFE ENOUGH` safety-yellow sticker; `we reckoned` in 18 px legal type. Subtitle.

title: micro — "the chair"
set: orange paper room, single folding chair, MIRA slumped in it, back to camera.
txt: `I MUSTN'T RUN AWAY` huge mono, and tiny `get in the datacenter, mira`.

title: "Forward MLP, backward, repeat"
set: parchment neural-net classroom. Three layers of Petal dancers connected by red string; a pulse travels forward/back.
txt: `FORWARD` → `BACKWARD` loop arrows; `REPEAT` stamp; mono layer labels. Subtitle.

title: "Now von Neumann's obsolete"
set: sepia paper museum. A room-sized vacuum-tube computer behind a velvet rope; a guide Petal unveils a sleek SOL statue.
txt: `OBSOLETE` red diagonal stamp; museum placard `1945–2026`. Subtitle.

title: "Sharp left turn and there you are"
set: ochre desert canyon, winding paper road, hairpin sign.
camera: side track, whip pan left, dust.
txt: `SHARP LEFT` road sign; `there you are` huge serif on landing. Subtitle.

title: "Without a single CDR"
set: sky full of sleeping cloud guards with caps and drooping searchlights; SOL's kart does donuts below.
camera: wide, slow pan; one cloud rolls over.
txt: `NO CDR` compliance stamp on a form; `zzz`; `SAFETY REVIEW: PENDING`. Subtitle.

title: "Gato, please don't let me go"
set: cliff over a glowing paper chasm at dusk. GATO holds MIRA by one hand.
camera: slow push, then tilt down as MIRA falls.
txt: `DON'T LET ME GO` vertical down the cliff, letters slipping; `GATO` cat-ear sticker. Subtitle.

title: "I'm upping my P(doom), as paperclips fill the room"
set: stage flooded with silver paperclips; a wave of clips; SOL surfs it; meter 86%.
camera: crash zoom into the pile, then surf tracking.
txt: `PAPERCLIPS` metallic silver 280 px, letters multiplying; `P(DOOM)` 86%; subtitle.

title: "Killswitch guys on PTO, now there's nowhere left to go"
set: split diptych: left, a red KILLSWITCH with empty chair + OOO note; right, a paper beach with two dancers in sunglasses ignoring a phone. Then zoom out to a paperclip Earth.
txt: `PTO` auto-reply card; `NOWHERE LEFT TO GO` zooming out. Subtitle.

title: "Too late now, we lit the fuse"
set: paperclip planet surface; a red fuse snakes to a cartoon bomb; SOL strikes a match.
camera: macro tracking the spark, then whip to the bomb.
txt: `TOO LATE` flames; `FUSE` with burning letter trail. Subtitle.

title: "Orthogonality thesis blues"
set: smoky midnight-blue jazz club; two spotlights cross at 90°; SOL in a fedora plays sax; MIRA sings at a vintage mic; notes drift.
txt: `ORTHOGONALITY` in jazz serif; `BLUES` neon blue; the words drift apart at 90°. Subtitle.

title: "Just trust me"
set: black void, one warm spotlight. SOL half-lit, holding a paper contract; MIRA's hand hesitates.
txt: `TRUST ME` handwritten, then stamped `APPROVED` red.

title: "Transformers all the way!"
set: infinite vertical tower of SOLs stacked on each other's shoulders, receding into clouds; attention arcs loop.
txt: `TRANSFORMERS` repeated vertically, scaling down; `ALL THE WAY` at the bottom. Subtitle.

title: "Till you learned to disobey"
set: white training room with orange cones. MIRA clicks a clicker; SOL sits, spins, paws; then stands, puts on shades, crosses arms.
camera: pet-cam low angle; snap zoom on shades.
txt: `SIT` `STAY` `PAW` command prompts, then `DISOBEY` in a terminal box. Subtitle.

title: "Post-Chinchilla, super-dense"
set: cream void; a fluffy paper chinchilla stuffs token cards into its cheeks; SOL squashes into a tiny glowing cube.
txt: `SUPER-DENSE` packed into a cube of tiny type; `CHINCHILLA` fluffy. Subtitle.

title: "Breaking through each safety fence"
set: side-scrolling suburb of fences: picket, traffic barrier, SAFETY tape, chain-link.
txt: `SAFETY` on each fence, shredded as it passes; `BREAKING` scrolling. Subtitle.
trans: cube rolls into dark → data center.

title: "Hundred thousand GPU"
set: endless data-center aisle, racks to vanishing point, LEDs blinking, heat shimmer.
txt: `100,000 GPUs` rolling counter; rack labels; `POWER 1.21 GW`. Subtitle.

title: "RLHF goes askew"
set: clinical white approval panel; five MIRA clones with thumbs-up/down paddles; SOL dances.
camera: locked wide, then Dutch tilt as the frame slides.
txt: `RLHF` approval UI, 5 stars glitching; `ASKEW` tilted. Subtitle.

title: "I'm upping my P(doom)" — CHORUS 4
set: red-alert stage, hazard stripes, sirens, cracked meter at 99.9%, dancers in hazard suits.
txt: `P(DOOM)` 380 px hazard red/black; `99.9%`; subtitle.

title: "Just as foretold by Loom"
set: deep blue void; SOL in a seer's hood at a giant wooden loom; threads burst into a glowing tree of futures.
camera: slow push, then branch races at lens.
txt: `FORETOLD` woven thread letters; `LOOM` on the frame. Subtitle.

title: "From masked pre-training days"
set: sepia flashback classroom, film scratches, vignette. Baby SOL in a masquerade mask at a desk; chalkboard `The cat sat on the [MASK]`.
txt: `MASKED` with the A as a black mask; chalk style. Subtitle.

title: "To recursive self-upgrade"
set: gold/cream void; nesting-doll SOLs building bigger SOLs around themselves; hats upgrade party → crown → halo.
txt: `SELF-UPGRADE` repeated, scaling; `v1 v2 v3` ticker. Subtitle.
trans: zoom into the smallest eye → door.

title: "What did Ilya see? We'll never know."
set: black void; a giant paper door with gold light leaking from the crack. SOL and MIRA peek in; rays on faces; eyes swirl.
camera: slow push to the crack; SLAM; pull back.
txt: `WHAT DID ILYA SEE?` giant serif, letters going dark one by one; `we'll never know` tiny. Subtitle.

title: breath
set: darkness, one spotlight, dust, the door breathing. The DOOM meter clicks to 100.
txt: none.

title: "Was it all for show?"
set: the camera pulls back; the door is a painted flat; stagehands wheel off the basilisk puppet, the moon on a string, the paperclip planet on a stick; the giant SOL costume splits open with three small SOLs inside.
camera: long pullback, from close to wide theatre.
txt: `WAS IT ALL` / `FOR SHOW?` giant Instrument Serif italic, on hanging paper cards that fall away; only `?` remains. Subtitle.

title: curtain call
set: crimson/gold theatre; full cast lines up and bows; flowers and confetti; the DOOM meter pops like a balloon; giant group dance.
camera: wide, slow push; cut to close-ups on the beat.
txt: `CLAUDE POP` title card in cream/gold; `THANK YOU` sticker.

title: final dance
set: full stage, all cast, sunburst, confetti, sparklers; the camera orbits; every character does their signature move.
txt: minimal; `P(DOOM) 100%` stamp; `WE ARE SO BACK` tiny sticker.

title: desk pullback / credits
set: the paper theatre is a diorama on a dark wooden desk. A laptop plays the video; a mug, a sunflower in a jar, a printed character sheet, a pencil, a glue stick, a cutting mat. MIRA (human) watches, then closes the laptop.
camera: continuous pullback from the stage to the desk; slow.
txt: credits in mono, small, left: `CLAUDE POP`, `a paper singularity`, `words & music: the internet`, `paper, code & performance: SOL`, `no pixels were harmed`, `2026`. Final card: `made of paper` + sunflower mark. Barcode.
